whenToUse: Comparing ordered items such as months or quarters.
You compare on the same scale while changing the period.
whenNotToUse: Item names are long (use a bar chart).
Trends with many points (use a line chart).
Showing composition (use a stacked bar chart).

alternatives.name: Histogram
alternatives.reason: Seeing the distribution of values in bins.
